value: landrace from the rocky west-coast island of Orust
historically free-ranged and ate whatever was available, including fish
black-and-white mottled feathers; roosters' wattles turn from red to violet when agitated

history_summary.value: The Orust is a Swedish landrace breed from the rocky coastal island it is named for, historically left to forage and survive largely unmanaged, which produced a hardy, opportunistic bird now considered extremely rare.
